transcript: A police officer, that is a cop, is an important profession that protects the order of society. They patrol the streets around the clock and react to incidents and accidents. Their work involves many areas. Investigating a crime, enforcing traffic laws, consulting with residents, Responding to reports of suspicious activity while respecting civil rights There are dramatic scenes of tracking down a killer But much of daily duty is steady, quiet work Writing documents, investigating the scene Communication with a supervisor The role of correctional facilities that manage prisoners is also important The aim is not only to punish criminals but also to rehabilitate them But the work of police has dangerous moments Armed criminals, gunshots, explosions They often face risks to their own wives Police function only with the trust of citizens If there is violence or corruption Their reputation is lost an instant In America, excessive violence against black people has continued And the Black Lives Matter movement has spread This is not a rebellion against the entire police But a voice demanding reform Japanese police are called affectionately Omowari-san, the co-ban Police box system is unique in the world By following legal, community-based security So officers too are human They make mistakes And they have emotions While we expect much of them We must not demand perfection Mutual understanding and cooperation Are the foundation of a safe society

segments.text: A police officer, that is a cop, is an important profession that protects the order of society.
They patrol the streets around the clock and react to incidents and accidents.
Their work involves many areas.
Investigating a crime, enforcing traffic laws, consulting with residents,
Responding to reports of suspicious activity while respecting civil rights
There are dramatic scenes of tracking down a killer
But much of daily duty is steady, quiet work
Writing documents, investigating the scene
Communication with a supervisor
The role of correctional facilities that manage prisoners is also important
The aim is not only to punish criminals but also to rehabilitate them
But the work of police has dangerous moments
Armed criminals, gunshots, explosions
They often face risks to their own wives
Police function only with the trust of citizens
If there is violence or corruption
Their reputation is lost an instant
In America, excessive violence against black people has continued
And the Black Lives Matter movement has spread
This is not a rebellion against the entire police
But a voice demanding reform
Japanese police are called affectionately
Omowari-san, the co-ban
Police box system is unique in the world
By following legal, community-based security
So officers too are human
They make mistakes
And they have emotions
While we expect much of them
We must not demand perfection
Mutual understanding and cooperation
Are the foundation of a safe society
